svg.title: RB2.1 — Product specs tab, v2, with the real NX drawings
svg.desc: Product specifications tab: Identity sub-tab, a Mechanical and electrical part list split into drawable parts and board materials, a selected component with its NX 2D drawing, and the drawing enlarged to the full data panel.
svg.text: 1 · PRODUCT SPECS → IDENTITY (SPECS lives inside Identity, per the Miro routine)
size confirmed by the CAD (dwg_upper / bottom_draw: 200 x 150, 15 + 45 deep)
2 · MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL — 8 drawable parts + 6 board materials, one scroll list
pinch a part, or pick from the list

g.text: BOARD MATERIALS · no drawing (not discrete parts)

svg.text: 3 · COMPONENT SELECTED — real NX drawing as preview, model highlights the part
Aluminium shell + Cu contacts, Au/Ni plated
4 · DRAWING ENLARGED — the tap target; dimensions become readable at 0.75 m
thiag_connectors · A4 · all dimensions in mm
WHAT THE CAD FOLDER ACTUALLY HOLDS: 8 NX sheets — dwg_upper, bottom_draw, pcb_drawing, connectors, component1/2/3/4_drawing.
They do NOT map 1:1 to the 11 payload rows. Housing = 1 payload row but 2 drawings. Actives = 1 payload row but 4 drawings.
Six payload rows have no drawing (passives, solder, TIM, coating, misc, fasteners) — correctly so: they are board materials, not parts.
CONSEQUENCE: masses shown in orange are group totals that no drawing can split. Either you supply a per-part mass, or the row keeps the group figure.
The Siemens title block, sheet frame and projection symbol are stripped; lines are inverted to white so they read on the navy panel.
NAMING: the four IC sheets are titled Processor 1..4. A VCU does not have four processors — rename to real functions before this reaches the thesis.
CONFIRMED, not a defect: the 200 x 150 x 60 in the payload IS the CAD demonstrator (dwg_upper 200 x 150 x 15, bottom_draw 200 x 150 x 45).
